criteria.text: Two pure functions live in `packages/engine/src/renderer/utils.ts`:
`healthFillRatio(current: number, max: number): number` returns the fraction
`healthBarColor(ratio: number): number` returns a Pixi colour number for the
Both are covered by unit tests in `packages/engine/src/renderer/utils.test.ts`,
The renderer (`packages/engine/src/renderer/index.ts`) gains an always-visible
The engine (`packages/engine/src/index.ts`) stores a current/max health pair
The example game (`example-game/game/index.ts`) calls `setPlayerHealth` once
The full engine package test suite passes
healthFillRatio(3,10) === 0.3
healthFillRatio(10,10) === 1
healthFillRatio(-5,10) === 0
healthFillRatio(20,10) === 1
healthFillRatio(5,0) === 0 and healthFillRatio(5,-1) === 0
healthBarColor(0) === 0xff3b30 and healthBarColor(0.35) === 0xff3b30
healthBarColor(1) === 0x34c759 and healthBarColor(0.61) === 0x34c759
healthBarColor(0.5) === 0xffcc00
DEV_HP_BAR_WIDTH, DEV_HP_BAR_HEIGHT, DEV_OVERLAY_MARGIN are exported from constants.ts with values 120, 10, 8
In devMode the renderer adds an HP-bar Container with two Graphics children (track + fill) to the stage
The HP-bar container's x equals app.screen.width - DEV_HP_BAR_WIDTH - DEV_OVERLAY_MARGIN and y equals DEV_OVERLAY_MARGIN
updateHealthBar(current,max) draws the fill with width DEV_HP_BAR_WIDTH * healthFillRatio(current,max) starting at local x=0 (left edge) growing rightward
The fill colour equals healthBarColor(healthFillRatio(current,max))
When devMode is false, updateHealthBar is a no-op and no HP-bar object is added to the stage
After resize(width,height) the HP-bar container repositions to the top-right using the updated app.screen.width
The existing dev overlay Text still renders at (8,8) and the F3 toggle behaviour is unchanged
engine.setPlayerHealth(current, max) exists on the returned engine object and stores the pair
Player health defaults to full (current === max) before setPlayerHealth is called
onRender calls renderer.updateHealthBar with the stored current/max health inside the devMode guard each frame
The ResizeObserver callback calls renderer.resize(w, h) (not app.renderer.resize directly) and then camera.setViewport with app.screen dimensions
The Engine interface in types/engine.ts declares setPlayerHealth: (current: number, max: number) => void and PlayerSystem is unchanged
example-game/game/index.ts calls engine.setPlayerHealth(3, 10) once
cd packages/engine && npx vitest run passes
